Name: Verify default values for optional CSV columns
Steps: 1. Open the CSV file with optional columns. 2. Check the default values for each optional column.
Expected: The optional columns should display the default values as specified.

Name: Verify user can browse clothing categories
Steps: 1. Navigate to the homepage of Style Haven. 2. Click on the 'Clothing' category. 3. Observe the displayed clothing items.
Expected: User should see a list of clothing items under the 'Clothing' category.

Name: Register a new user account
Steps: 1. Navigate to the registration page. 2. Enter a valid email and password. 3. Click on the 'Register' button.
Expected: User account is created successfully and user is redirected to the login page.

Name: Search products by keyword
Steps: 1. Navigate to the product catalog page. 2. Enter 'shoes' in the search bar. 3. Click the search button.
Expected: The product list displays items related to 'shoes'.

Name: Add item to shopping cart
Steps: 1. Navigate to the product page. 2. Click on 'Add to Cart' button for a product.
Expected: The item is added to the shopping cart and the cart count is updated.

Name: Verify order confirmation email generation
Steps: Complete a purchase using any payment method.
Expected: An order confirmation email is received with purchase details.

Name: Create a product listing with images
Steps: 1. Log in as a seller. 2. Navigate to the product listing section. 3. Fill in the product details including title, description, and upload images. 4. Submit the product listing.
Expected: The product listing is created successfully and appears in the seller's dashboard.

Name: Verify live chat support functionality
Steps: 1. Navigate to the customer support page. 2. Click on the live chat button. 3. Enter a message in the chat window. 4. Send the message.
Expected: The message is sent successfully and a response is received from the support agent.
